## Capability inventory (all existing — do not suggest as new)

### Trust and verification
- CA-verified accounts (NGOs, companies, individuals)
- CA-verified NGO credibility badges via empanelled auditors
- FCRA certificate-checked badges
- 12A certificate-checked badges
- 80G certificate-checked badges
- Section 8 / Trust / Society certificate verification on profiles
- Verified identity layer across stakeholder types

### Directory and access
- Active, accurate NGO directory
- Donation accessibility to verified NGOs only
- Multi-stakeholder connections: NGO ↔ Company ↔ Volunteer/Individual

### CSR and execution (Phase 2 architecture)
- CSR campaign management
- CSR project management
- NGO-company CSR collaboration workflows
- Milestone-based project execution
- Milestone-linked payment progress
- Volunteer and service engagement marketplace

### Field operations and evidence
- Offline-first field evidence capture
- Image-first progressive web app
- Capacitor Android native shell
- Context-linked evidence (project, milestone, location, operator, device, timestamp)
- Hash-chained append-only evidence event ledger
- Local storage with background sync queue
- Evidence verification and review workflows
- Impact tracking and operational intelligence
